definitions.gloss: to obligate; to make mandatory; to require by rule or law
definitions.explanation: To impose an obligation or requirement, typically through law, regulation, or organizational rules. Often used in passive form to describe what is required.

examples.japanese: {届|とど}け{出|で}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{義務付|ぎむづ}けられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{義務付|ぎむづ}ける。
⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}{公開|こうかい}→情報公開：21260_jouhoukoukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{義務付|ぎむづ}けられるようになった。
examples.english: Companies became required to disclose information.

notes:
An ichidan verb formed from ⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧ (obligation, duty) + {付|づ}ける (to attach). Creates the meaning of attaching an obligation to something or someone. Very frequently used in passive form ({義務付|ぎむづ}けられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧) to describe existing requirements.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive — takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the action being made mandatory, and ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark who is obligated.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {義務付|ぎむづ}けられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ — is required, is mandatory
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{義務付|ぎむづ}ける — to require by law
- {義務付|ぎむづ}けられた⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧ — mandatory training

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{義務化|ぎむか}→義務化：28603_gimuka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to make obligatory (noun + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ form)
- ⟦{強制|きょうせい}→強制：12500_kyousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to compel, to force (stronger, more coercive)
- {課|か}す — to impose (a duty, tax, etc.)
